Unbroken Vigil.name: Unbroken Vigil
Unbroken Vigil.description: The user keeps both hands on a dying person and does not let go. While contact holds, the user can do nothing but walk beside a stretcher, and the patient cannot die from their wounds or blood loss, holding on until a surgeon or a stronger technique can save them; they lose heavy stamina when the user lets go. Strain: heavy.
